seo.title: How the 16th Panzer Division raced to the Volga River
seo.description:
In August 1942, the 16th Panzer Division made a lightning-fast advance to reach Stalingrad and the Volga River. However, this incredible speed ultimately trapped Friedrich Paulus's troops in a fatal, grinding battle that ended on February 2, 1943.

#WorldWar2 #Stalingrad #MilitaryHistory #EasternFront
